h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.description: Hopper 2-GPU TP SGLang qwen_image_2512_t2i_1024: resident DiT + torch.compile (best-lossless). Same validated command as flux1/flux2 speed-compile.
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.sglang_ref: origin/main + PR #29774 (QwenImage TP shard) + selective txt_mlp ReplicatedLinear (proposed #29774 follow-up)
h100-h200-2gpu-tp-speed-compile.notes: no-CFG single-branch: TP shard (#29774) but keep text-branch txt_mlp ReplicatedLinear to skip its per-block all-reduce. Measured H100: full-shard 5.65s -> txt_mlp-replicated 5.076s, beats vLLM 5.17s. (true-CFG uses CFG-parallel instead — see the truecfg case.) offload-during-compile is in main. Selective-shard qwen_image.py kept at reports/h100x4-final-20260702/qwen_image_selective_shard.py.
